title: Bighomiekayden - Invincible!
htmlContent:
Bighomiekayden's "Invincible!" is brilliant story telling matched with true soul to make it resonate to the fullest. The intricacies in the writing are superb to bring the vision to us, while letting his artistry bring us a masterpiece for us to enjoy every aspect of. Hit play now and enjoy this major sound by this major talent.

Bighomiekayden brings a presence that you feel right away, and delivers the story telling with a melodic tone to convey the right amount of emotion at every turn, as the story telling of chasing your dreams, while being in a failing relationship comes to life for us all to follow.
